verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents its own reporting on completed transactions: three report types, plus itemized exports with a line-item tax breakdown for every transaction. Filing help is limited to the US, through a TaxJar integration. The evidence never shows a per-jurisdiction accrued-liability view, a collected-versus-owed reconciliation, or GL-ready export formats. Missing for 10: real-time liability by jurisdiction, collected vs owed comparison, documented GL/accountant export formats, filing-ready summaries outside the US, independent corroboration of report usefulness.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see accrued liability by jurisdiction at any moment — collected versus owed, filing-ready detail, and exports my accountant and GL can consume

citations.quote: Stripe Tax provides reports of completed transactions, and it provides three different kinds of reports
Itemized exports contain a detailed view of the line item level tax breakdown for every transaction.
Calculate and report tax on all payments, even those that you process outside of Stripe.
Stripe Tax integrates with TaxJar to automate filing for US sales tax
